protocol.includes: TAST loading/sorting, preparation, PBO/generation, final emission and drain
protocol.excludes: frontend, compiler/application builds, application execution and process startup/exit
protocol.order: Serialized projects; JS/Rust and Rust/JS alternate over warmup and five measured rounds
protocol.cache: Fresh generated output and PBO caches; warm OS filesystem cache; fresh process per run
protocol.purust_jobs: Public defaults: JS 1/1; native worker budget 8 split into 4 PBO and 4 codegen workers
protocol.output_mode: Primary package runner flags; threaded where requested by the package
protocol.exact_output: Per-run manifests and byte comparisons; canonical identical output retained once per project

rerun.reason: A native HTTP application exposed a truncated primed foreign identifier; all projects are re-measured with the corrected qualified hosts.
